name: target_cavity_volume
note: The volume the simulator assumes. This is the whole point of the part: it is the acceptance criterion.

name: design_pressure
note: Regulated supply gauge pressure. Worst credible internal pressure.

name: probe_hold_pressure
note: Operating point of the decay probe. Lower than design pressure.

name: bore_diameter
note: Chosen for machinability and a sensible aspect ratio. Any value is admissible provided the derived length keeps the cavity at target_cavity_volume.

name: cavity_length
note: Solved so the cavity equals the target volume exactly. Not a free choice.

name: wall_thickness
note: Manufacturing minimum for a sealed printed pressure part. NOT stress-governed - see the hoop-stress check in DESIGN_NOTES.md which shows ~35x margin.

name: end_cap_thickness
note: Flat closure carries bending rather than hoop stress; thicker than the wall by inspection. TODO check as a flat circular plate if the part is ever pressurised above design_pressure.

name: port_thread
note: TODO measure the fitting on the existing volumetric drive. M5 is the common pneumatic barb boss but nothing in this repository specifies it.

name: material_allowable_stress
note: TODO obtain from the print material datasheet AND derate for layer adhesion and print orientation. 30 MPa is a placeholder order of magnitude for PLA and must not be used as a design allowable.

name: safety_factor
note: Against material allowable. Justified in DESIGN_NOTES.md by property scatter in printed parts plus an unverified allowable.
